title: 第19章 主持公道第20章 欠条变借条
content_zh:
不多时，汪庆中带着一大群人回来了。
这些人都是在中段区域捡漏的杂役弟子，别说这么巨大的青花玉，就是碗口大小的，都没挖到过。
当听说其中门道后，一个个直接惊呆了，吞咽之声此起彼伏。
若非汪庆中在这里，恐怕会立刻爆发一场血案。
不过现在嘛，就另当别论了。
且不说，汪庆中是玉石仓库管理者，杀了汪庆中，这玉石也没人收。
就是汪庆中的实力，也不是他们这群杂鱼能够应付的！这不仅仅是境界的压制。
更重要的是，汪庆中已修行多年，其法术运用的纯熟度，绝不是他们这种新人能够比较的。
于是。
在汪庆中的主持下，所有人齐齐发力，将这块巨石单独挖了出来。
然后，开始清理表层石皮。
韩林在帮忙翻滚玉石时，不小心划破了手掌。
鲜血滴在玉石表面，他也没在意，抓起一把沙土洒在手掌上，将伤口敷住，又继续干活。
一群人忙活了好一阵子，终于将表层石皮全部处理干净，露出一块巨大无比、完整的青花玉。
雪白的光芒让通道都亮了几分。
众人用木杠，粗绳，绑住青花玉，将其抬回了营地。
但因为体型实在太大，根本无法进入仓库，于是汪庆中用‘吃水法’称出青花玉重量后，就将其摆在了库房外面。
这么大的青花玉，相信也没人敢偷。
“大家辛苦了，每人五十点积分的辛苦费，中午休息时间到了，你们直接去食堂吃饭就是。”
忙完后，汪庆中取出一叠积分卡，以及饭牌分发给众人。

“谢谢汪师兄！”
众人顿时惊喜不已，暗道没白忙。
五十点积分啊。
他们这些人，运气不好的话，忙碌一个月也挣不到。
“呵呵不用谢我，这是从韩林的奖励中扣的，要谢就谢他吧！”汪师兄咧着嘴笑道。
韩林嘴角抽了抽，一阵无语。
三十五人，这可是将近两千积分啊，你倒是真舍得！
“哈哈，谢谢韩师弟！“
众人闻言，纷纷对韩林抱拳行礼。
“不用客气，还是多亏诸位师兄，我才能将这青花玉搬出来。”韩林笑着抱拳回应，实则内心在滴血。
众人离开后，他立刻凑到汪庆中身旁：“汪师兄，啥时候把积分给我？”
“瞧把你急的，跟我来吧。”
汪庆中带着韩林走进库房，来到一个柜子前面，用钥匙打开抽屉，从里面取出一叠积分卡数了起来。
随后将一叠积分卡放在桌上：“玉石9850斤，扣除你承诺给我的一成利，还剩8865，再扣除刚才的劳工费，还剩7115。这里是七千一百点积分，剩下的十五点，就当你请我喝酒了如何？”
“没有问题。”
韩林将积分卡收了起来，虽然比想象中的要少很多，但也相当不错了。
告别了汪庆中，韩林先去食堂吃了个饭，然后就直奔百货坊。
杨福早已听到广场动静，见韩林进门，顿时心头一跳：“韩林，难道那玉石是你发现的？”
“正是。”
“天，你小子的运气也太惊人了吧。”

“哈哈，还行还行！”
韩林笑着说罢，“杨老，还是老规矩，这里是七千一百点积分，全部换成灵石。”
外人都说他运气好，只有韩林自己知道，这根本不是运气，而是靠他的通天眼辛苦找来的。
当然了。
content_en:
Not long after, Wang Qingzhong came back with a large group of people.
These people are all handyman disciples who pick up leaks in the middle area. Not to mention such a huge blue and white jade, even the size of a bowl, they have never dug up.
When they heard about the doorway, everyone was stunned, and the sounds of swallowing came one after another.
If Wang Qingzhong hadn't been here, a murder would have broken out immediately.
But now, it's a different story.
Not to mention, Wang Qingzhong was the manager of the jade warehouse. Even if Wang Qingzhong was killed, no one would take the jade.
Even Wang Qingzhong's strength is not something that a group of miscellaneous fish like them can handle! This is not just a state of suppression.
More importantly, Wang Qingzhong has been practicing for many years, and his proficiency in using magic is by no means comparable to that of newcomers like them.
then.
Under the auspices of Wang Qingzhong, everyone worked together to dig out the huge boulder alone.
Then, start cleaning the surface stone skin.
Han Lin accidentally cut his palm while helping to turn the jade.
Blood dripped on the surface of the jade, but he didn't care. He grabbed a handful of sand and sprinkled it on his palm, covered the wound, and continued working.
A group of people worked hard for a while, and finally cleaned up all the surface stone skin, revealing a huge and complete piece of blue and white jade.
The snow-white light made the passage a little brighter.
The crowd tied the blue and white jade with wooden poles and thick ropes and carried it back to the camp.
But because it was too big, it was impossible to enter the warehouse, so Wang Qingzhong used the 'draft method' to weigh the blue and white jade and placed it outside the warehouse.
I believe no one would dare to steal such a big blue and white jade.
"Thank you everyone for your hard work. Each person deserves 50 points for their hard work. It's time for the lunch break. You can just go to the cafeteria to eat."
After finishing his work, Wang Qingzhong took out a stack of point cards and meal cards and distributed them to everyone.
"Thank you, Senior Brother Wang!"
Everyone was immediately pleasantly surprised, secretly saying that their work was not in vain.
Fifty points.
If they are unlucky, they won't be able to earn even if they work for a month.
"Haha, don't thank me. This is deducted from Han Lin's reward. If you want to thank him, just thank him!" Senior Brother Wang said with a grin.
Han Lin's mouth twitched and he was speechless for a while.
Thirty-five people, this is nearly two thousand points, you are really willing to give it up!
"Haha, thank you, Junior Brother Han!"
After everyone heard this, they all saluted Han Lin with fists in their hands.
"You're welcome. Thanks to all the senior brothers, I was able to move this blue and white jade out." Han Lin responded with a smile and cupped his fists, but his heart was actually bleeding.
After everyone left, he immediately approached Wang Qingzhong: "Senior Brother Wang, when will you give me the points?"
"Look how anxious you are, come with me."
Wang Qingzhong led Han Lin into the warehouse, came to a cabinet, opened the drawer with a key, took out a stack of point cards and started counting them.
Then he put a stack of point cards on the table: "The jade is 9850 kilograms. After deducting the 10% profit you promised me, there is still 8865. After deducting the labor fee just now, there are still 7115. Here are 7100 points. The remaining 15 points can be treated as if you invited me to drink?"
"No problem."
Han Lin put away the points card. Although it was much less than expected, it was still quite good.
After bidding farewell to Wang Qingzhong, Han Lin went to the cafeteria to have a meal and then went straight to the department store.
Yang Fu had already heard the commotion in the square, and when he saw Han Lin entering the door, his heart skipped a beat: "Han Lin, was it you who discovered the jade?"
"Exactly."
"God, your luck is so amazing."
"Haha, it's okay, it's okay!"
Han Lin smiled and said, "Mr. Yang, it's still the same old rules. Here are 7,100 points, all converted into spiritual stones."
Outsiders say that he is lucky, but only Han Lin himself knows that this is not luck at all, but the result of hard work thanks to his clairvoyance.
Of course.
